Hello LAVAAN members

Structural Equation Modeling 3: Advanced Topics led by Kevin Grimm (Department of Psychology, Arizona State University) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This on-demand seminar, 'Structural Equation Modeling 3: Advanced Topics,' explores sophisticated methods including growth models, binary and ordinal outcomes, and power analysis. Researchers utilizing the lavaan package in R can leverage these advanced SEM techniques to model individual change over time, test measurement invariance, and specify complex latent variable structures within their existing analytical framework. Applying these skills will enable the community to conduct more robust analyses, address intricate research questions, and develop highly predictive models using their preferred R environment.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
